reportAnomalyAudit.rootCauseDescription: The identical-to-4-decimal anomaly (0.6129 and 0.6421) is caused by AH 0.0 code using identical logic (h>a, h===a, h<a) and identical target indices (actual1x2 === actualAh) as Moneyline. Model 2 AH Brier of 0.5892 reported in Table B was an unverified copy-paste of Moneyline Brier (0.5892); the actual code produced 0.6421.

evidence: Mathematical & Target Equivalence: 100.0% of matches (1140/1140) produced identical probability vectors for ML [pHome, pDraw, pAway] and AH 0.0 [pCover, pPush, pFail] in Model 0 and Model 1, with identical actual outcome indices (actual1x2 === actualAh0 for 100% of rows). This confirms Pearson r = 1.0000 and identical Brier scores (M0: 0.6129, M1: 0.6421).

Report Table B Reproduction Discrepancy: MODEL_TOURNAMENT_REPORT.md Table B reported Model 2 AH Brier as 0.5892. Actual code execution of Model 2 AH produces 0.6421. The reported 0.5892 was an unverified copy-paste of Model 2 Moneyline Brier (0.5892 in Table A / ~0.5975 in code).

Odds-Derived Feature Sensitivity (Circularity in ML/Market Ensemble): Ablation across market weights shows pure football Model 1 achieves Brier 0.6421, while pure de-vigged market odds (weight 1.0) achieves Brier 0.5618. The apparent superiority of Model 2 (Brier ~0.59) is entirely driven by borrowing 35% de-vigged market odds, not independent fundamental prediction.

AH Champion Disqualification: Model 2 was selected as AH champion in EPIC 54 based on false reported metrics (Brier 0.5892, CLV +2.80%, ROI +18.50%) that do not exist in the code output and were evaluated only at AH line 0.0 (mirroring Moneyline).
recommendedNextAction: Disqualify the EPIC 54 Model 2 AH champion as a baseline. For Stage B, construct an independent AsianHandicapModel trained directly on multi-line handicap targets (quarter, half, integer) using pure football primitives (λ_home, λ_away) without market-odds features.
